def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    two_year_spot_rate = 0.025
    four_year_spot_rate = 0.055
    start_year = 2
    end_year = 4

    # Calculate the two-year forward rate starting two years from now
    forward_rate = (
        ((1 + four_year_spot_rate) ** end_year)
        / ((1 + two_year_spot_rate) ** start_year)
    ) ** (1 / (end_year - start_year)) - 1

    # Return the percentage rounded to three decimal places
    answer = round(forward_rate * 100, 3)
    return answer
